trigger: crafted agent_id/rule_id pair colliding under delimited-string pair_key(agent_id,rule_id)=agent_id+'\x1f'+rule_id
independent_reporters: 3 of 12 (security-guardian Gate2; architect Gate3; compliance-officer Gate6 - each in a separate wave, could not see one another)
summary: has_real_status's composite key was an unescaped string join; agent_id (length-checked only at Register) and rule_id (unvalidated on REST create) are not guaranteed separator-free, so a crafted pair could collide with an unrelated pair's real status row and silently drop the crafted pair from every compliance bucket.
classification: truth (own new code, not a comment)

independent_reporters: 5 of 6 (Gate 8 wave 1, each independently re-verified against b24c9565b)
summary: Fixed by replacing the delimited string key with PairStatusKey{std::string agent_id; std::string rule_id;} struct + PairStatusKeyHash functor (no delimiter to collide on for any byte content). quality-engineer empirically reverted the fix and confirmed the new regression test fails on the old key and passes on the new one.

trigger: crafted agent_id containing embedded newline, interpolated raw into note_platform_matrix_stale's spdlog::info line
summary: agent_id/rule_id/spark_type interpolated unescaped into the new diagnostic log line could forge a fake multi-line log entry.
Fixed via the existing log_safe() helper (web_utils.hpp), applied to all 3 interpolated values; verified it strips \n/\r (c<0x20||c==0x7f).

summary: kKnownGuardSparkTypes now single-sourced + cross-checked against the schema catalog (2 of 3 legs bound). The array<->if-chain leg is NOT mechanically bound - own comments initially overclaimed this; corrected wording plus a new matrix-pin test in test_guardian_push_builder.cpp fails loudly if a 4th array entry has no corresponding pinned platform check, but the enforcement is test-only, not compile-time. Accepted residual, accurately documented now.

waiver_rationale: a compile-time binding between a hardcoded if-chain and a data array is architecturally awkward in this codebase's existing idiom; test-level pinning plus accurate documentation of the residual gap is the proportionate fix for a rollup-display bug PR, not a store-schema-scale refactor.

trigger: a same-rule_id guard-type revision leaving the replacement guard unarmed, with the prior status row surviving
independent_reporters: pre-governance adversarial-review pass, 2 external models converged
provenance: pre-existing, root cause in guaranteed_state_store.cpp (update_rule never invalidates guardian_agent_rule_status on revision, unlike delete_rule)
summary: A stale status row from an earlier rule revision can render a currently-unenforced guard as compliant.
adjudicated_by: orchestrator, adjudicated MEDIUM not HIGH: root cause outside this diff's files, a live detection signal (the new counter) already fires on this exact condition, and Codex's proposed alternative fix was proven unsafe (reintroduces #4252-style double-counting for the deliberate matrix-lag case the exclusion predicate exists for)
waiver_rationale: store-schema fix belongs in its own PR, not bundled into a dashboard-rollup display fix; disclosed in the changelog fragment and guaranteed-state.md, tracked as issue #4263.
